CheckTitle: Check Lambda Function URL is not publicly accessible (AuthType NONE)
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks whether Lambda function URLs use AuthType NONE, making the function invocable by anyone on the internet.
Risk: Unauthenticated function URLs allow anyone to invoke the function, abusing its role permissions and running up cost.

Recommendation.Text: Use AuthType AWS_IAM for function URLs or front the function with an authenticated API Gateway.

Notes: Not a numbered CIS AWS 3.0 control; mapped to 1.16 (least privilege / unauthenticated access).
